context: Hina-young plays shogi with Hiroshi-elder; quiet evening.
purpose: Teen and grandfather playing strategy game.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、将棋、私の番!
lines.en: Grandpa, it's my turn with shogi!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Voice full of anticipation but not frantic. Leans forward slightly. Wants his attention and his approval equally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おう、駒、よく動かしとるな。
lines.en: Yeah, you're really moving those pieces well.
lines.style: Warm approval, measured pace. Light pride in the observation. Quiet Kansai cadence. Patient elder settling into the game with her.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Genuine delight, almost surprised at herself. Bright but not performed. A small moment of discovery in her voice. Open on the exclamation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: This match is in a tough spot, isn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Kansai warmth underneath. Not lecturing—observing alongside her. Soft, almost contemplative tone.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 止める所、見つけられない!
lines.en: I can't find the right move!
lines.style: Frustration rising but still trusting. A note of doubt creeping in. Seeking reassurance but trying first. Quick pace, slight strain in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 振り返って、ようけ考えてみ。
lines.en: Take a breath and think it through again.
lines.style: Gentle anchor. No rush in the phrasing. Kansai lilt on the close. The voice of someone who has waited through many difficult moments with her.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah, I'm going to try harder!
lines.style: Resolve settling in. Voice steadier now. Not loud—determined quietly. A nod to his encouragement, drawing strength from it.
